connector.name: Gotify MCP by tootie.tv
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for self-hosted Gotify push notifications and message management.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package gotify-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace tv.tootie. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GOTIFY_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Gotify server, e.g. https://gotify.example.com. No trailing slash.

env.name: GOTIFY_APP_TOKEN
env.description: Gotify application token for sending messages (Settings > Apps > Create Application).

env.name: GOTIFY_CLIENT_TOKEN
env.description: Gotify client token for management operations (Settings > Clients).

env.name: GOTIFY_MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Set to 'stdio' when running as a local subprocess. Default is 'http' for container deployments.
